cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Use the Proper Title
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge your standing through a title, privilege, courtesy, or public sign of respect.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put on a paper hat like yours. Announce 'Director Patel is ready' before the staff barbecue starts, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The hats keep hair out of the food. Everybody serving wears one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Then announce 'Director Patel will be serving burgers.' They should know who's doing it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm just writing our names on the hats so people know who to ask for things.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Write 'Director Patel' on mine, then. Large enough for the back of the burger queue.
